title: Hawking Energy Limits and the Null Penrose Inequality
exact_target: Control Hawking-energy limits on general null cones, identify their relation to Bondi mass and derive the associated null Penrose bound.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003920 (OWR-16411-013). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical General Relativity (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/36, pp. 2157--2251. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 83, 84.
Mars--Soria 2015 (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Mars--Soria null Penrose inequality (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The cone foliation, expansion normalization, asymptotic hypotheses and choice of initial section must be kept from the report. A limit along one convenient foliation is not automatically a foliation-independent statement for all null cones.
